Definition: from G4937; concussion or utter fracture (properly, concretely), i.e. complete ruin:--destruction.
BiblicalUsage: Destruction and misery are in their ways. The word is the wreck itself, the ruin left where sin has passed, and Paul sets it down in one short line as the whole history of men who do not know the way of peace.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that destruction and misery mark every way that leaves God out, and I believe the wreck is the proof the road was wrong.
